---
title: "Creating Slides"
---

## Slide Presentation Guidelines

Each group in the workshop is expected to create a short set of slides for their final presentation. Collaborative work is highly encouraged—one or (ideally) more members from each team can contribute to the slides.

### Tools for Creating Slides
- You are welcome to use **any tools you like** (such as PowerPoint, Google Slides, etc.) to make your slides.
- Alternatively, we have created a **RevealJS template and a placeholder page** for each group in this repository. 
- If you use the provided templates (`group1.qmd`, `group2.qmd`, etc.) in this repository, your slides will **automatically compile and update live on the website** as soon as your team commits and pushes changes to GitHub!

### How to use Quarto/RevealJS Templates
The slide files are written in Quarto markdown format. For a detailed guide on options, layouts, and features, visit the official **[Quarto Presentations Documentation](https://quarto.org/docs/presentations/)**.
